_comment: Category hooks for datapack and modpack authors.
Each entry below targets one of Florafare's own item tags, and every one of those
tags ships EMPTY - so out of the box this file changes nothing at all. Add your
mod's food to data/<your_pack>/tags/item/florafare/<category>.json and it picks up
that category's buff, with no need to copy or override any of Florafare's files.
Priority 1 matches the per-item files, so these win against a broad catch-all tag
left at the default priority of 0, and lose to anything a pack deliberately raises
above them. A named entry for the item itself always wins regardless: the item-id
lookup runs before tags are considered at all. Put an item in one category only -
two matching tags at the same priority resolve deterministically, but by tag name
The numbers are the medians of the matching bundled category, so a food joining a
category lands in the middle of it rather than at either extreme.
